verdict.summary: Equinox Gold is a mid-tier North American gold producer trading at an extreme discount (6.4x forward PE, 5.97x EV/EBITDA) after a 46% drawdown from its 52-week high of $18.96. The transformative Orla Mining merger (closing Q3 2026) creates a 1.1M oz/year senior gold producer with a funded growth path to 1.9M oz/year. Revenue growth of +224% YoY and 58.9% gross margins at $4,100+ gold are compelling, but the Q1 2026 EPS miss ($0.23 vs $0.29 est.), 33% all-share merger dilution, a $100M ATM program, and completely broken technical structure (price below all EMAs, RSI 37.7) cap the grade at B+. This is a deep value contrarian play for gold bulls with a high tolerance for volatility — not a momentum setup.

business.overview:
Equinox Gold is a mid-tier gold producer headquartered in Vancouver, operating mines across North America (Canada, USA, Mexico). The company produced a record 922,827 ounces in 2025 from a diversified portfolio anchored by the flagship Greenstone Mine in Ontario (commercial production achieved 2024).

In May 2026, Equinox announced a transformative all-share merger with Orla Mining ($5.1B deal backed by Pierre Lassonde), creating a senior gold producer with 1.1M oz annual production and a funded growth trajectory to 1.9M oz. The combined entity has an implied market cap of ~$18.5B. The company's North American footprint was simplified in January 2026 when Brazil operations were sold and $1.1B in debt was retired.

risks.pedagogy: The price is cheap for a reason: 33% merger dilution, 72.8% share growth in one year, a Q1 EPS miss, and broken technicals make EQX the market's least-loved major gold miner. The bull case rests entirely on gold prices staying above $3,500 and the Orla merger successfully creating a re-ratable senior producer. At $4,100+ gold, the fundamental value is undeniable — but timing the re-rating requires patience and stomach for volatility.

tradeIdea.thesis: Equinox Gold trades at an extreme fundamental discount (6.4x fwd PE, 5.97x EV/EBITDA, 1.32x P/B) to every single gold mining peer. At $4,123/oz gold, EQX earns $2,248-2,348 margin per ounce on AISC of $1,775-1,875. The stock is the worst-performing major gold miner in 2026 (-32% YTD vs GDX +20%), creating an asymmetric catch-up opportunity if the merger closes successfully. The contrarian thesis: the Orla merger overhang, Q1 EPS miss, and dilution history have pushed EQX to levels that discount far worse outcomes than reality. RBC maintains Outperform with a $14 target (36% upside). This is a deep value position trade with a defined catalyst timeline (merger vote July, close Q3).
